cards.text: Last time, Saul told David, "May you be blessed, David my son." Then he went home (1 Samuel 26:25). But I don't think David's unpacking his bags just yet, friend, because he says to himself, "One of these days now I will be swept away by the hand of Saul."

cards.question: David decides there's nothing better for him than to escape, so Saul will stop searching all over Israel. Where does he plan to go?

cards.text: So David sets out with his men for Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath. The LAST time David was in Gath, he pretended to be insane and let his spit run down his beard (1 Samuel 21:13), and now he's moving BACK?!

cards.question: David sets out for Gath with his ___ hundred men.
David and his men settle in Gath with Achish. Each man has his family with him.

cards.text: And David's got his two wives with him: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal. Whole households, friend. This isn't a weekend trip. This is a MOVE.

cards.question: When Saul learns that David has fled to Gath, he keeps searching for him.
Once David's settled in Gath, he goes to King Achish with a request. What does David ask for?

answers.text: A place in one of the outlying towns
A home right inside the royal city
Command over part of the army

cards.question: That day Achish gives David the town of ___.

cards.text: The text says that to this day, Ziklag still belongs to the kings of Judah. And David's time in Philistine territory? A year and four months.
Now David and his men go up and raid the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. These people had lived since ancient times in the land stretching to Shur and Egypt.
Whenever David attacks, he leaves no man or woman alive. He takes the flocks and herds, the donkeys, camels and clothing, and heads back to Achish.

cards.question: Back in Gath, Achish asks David, "What have you raided today?" What does David tell him?
David leaves no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath. He says that otherwise they would ___ what he did.
After all of David's reports, Achish starts to suspect that David is lying to him.

cards.text: Achish trusts David, thinking, "Since he has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel, he will be my servant forever." Then the Philistines gather their forces for war against Israel. Uh-oh.

cards.question: With the Philistines gathering for war against Israel, what does Achish tell David?

answers.text: He and his men will go to battle with Achish
He and his men will stay behind and guard Gath
He and his men must leave Philistine land for now

cards.text: And David answers, "Then you will come to know what your servant can do." Friend, I've read that line TEN times, and I still can't tell you whose side it's promising to help.

cards.question: Achish hears David say he'll show what he can do. What does Achish make David?

cards.text: The bodyguard of a Philistine king, with a war against Israel on the way. We'll stop right there, friend, but trust me, this story is NOT done.
